subject: Book fair prices - some kids left in tears

triage.summary: A parent complains that the book fair's high minimum price ($9) excluded several children, causing two to leave in tears, and asks for a more inclusive approach to fundraising.
triage.proposed_action: Forward to the PTA/board leadership and the book fair organizer to review pricing and consider inclusive options (e.g., lower-priced items, voucher system, donation fund) so no child is singled out.

details.complaint_topic: pricing too high, children unable to participate

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'complaint' requires human decision (conflicts need a human touch)
